FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Valuation Dynamics, LLC, we specialize in providing comprehensive actuarial and appraisal services. Our operations revolve around delivering precise valuations for a variety of assets, including real estate, personal property, and business enterprises. Our team comprises highly qualified actuaries and appraisers, ensuring that all methodologies adhere to industry standards and best practices. We pride ourselves on maintaining robust data verification processes and quality assurance protocols to minimize errors and uphold the integrity of our reports. Our use of secure, cloud-based technology platforms ensures efficient delivery of services while safeguarding client data. Additionally, we emphasize continuous professional development through regular training on compliance, ethics, and data security for all employees. Our business ethos is founded on transparency and accountability, which not only fosters strong relationships with our clients but also reflects our commitment to professional integrity in the actuarial and appraisal sectors.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a client filed a claim regarding an appraisal that resulted in an incorrect property valuation due to data entry errors, amounting to $7,500. This loss is currently under review for resolution. Additionally, on 10/30/2022, we experienced a loss of $7,500 due to a miscommunication with a client that resulted in a delay in deliverables, which is also being addressed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
